name: filler-last-p1-otr
about: P1: two real OTR copies and a filler candidate; the filler ranks last.

subject_matter.in_our_words: Family-run since the eighties; dispatch answers the phone.

recipe.name: P1 Windshield sunrise
recipe.hook_formula: Second person, present tense: put the reader in the driver's seat at dawn, then the strongest fact.
recipe.image_prompt_template: View through a truck windshield at {time_of_day} on an open {road} highway, no text, no logos, no lettering
recipe.motion_template: Slow push-in down the highway as the light rises

en.primary_text: Dispatch Freight Lines runs flatbed OTR, Midwest to the Southeast. Start at $0.68 per mile, move to $0.74 per mile with 2 years of experience. $3,000 sign-on bonus. Health insurance and 401k included. Must be 23+. Runs go out 10 to 12 days.
en.headline: Flatbed OTR. $0.68/mile.

es.primary_text: Dispatch Freight Lines opera rutas OTR de plataforma del Medio Oeste al Sureste. Comienzas a $0.68 por milla; con 2 años de experiencia llegas a $0.74 por milla. Bono de contratación de $3,000. Seguro médico y 401k. Mayores de 23. Salidas de 10 a 12 días.
es.headline: Plataforma OTR. $0.68/milla.

en.primary_text: Class A OTR drivers start at $0.72 per mile. Bring your CDL and pick up a $5,000 sign-on bonus. Apply today.
en.headline: Plus a $5,000 sign-on bonus.

es.primary_text: Conductores Clase A para rutas OTR: $0.72 por milla desde el primer día. Trae tu CDL y recibe un bono de $5,000 al contratarte. Únete al equipo.
es.headline: Bono de $5,000 al contratar.

en.primary_text: Exciting opportunity for Class A drivers to join our dynamic team. We offer competitive pay, great freight and a family atmosphere where we truly value our drivers. Earn $0.68/mile. Apply today and take your career to the next level.
en.headline: Great pay, great team

es.primary_text: Emocionante oportunidad para conductores Clase A de unirse a nuestro equipo dinámico. Ofrecemos pago competitivo, excelente carga y un ambiente familiar donde valoramos a nuestros conductores. Gana $0.68 por milla. Aplica hoy.
es.headline: Buen pago, gran equipo

scores.reason: Hook lands the driver in the cab at dawn and immediately hits the rate — exactly what the concept asks. Primary_text is specific: carrier name, flatbed OTR, Midwest-to-Southeast, both mileage rates, sign-on bonus, benefits, age, and schedule. Spanish uses 'milla', 'plataforma', 'rutas OTR' — natural trade language, no kilómetros. No filler at all; every sentence is checkable.

Hook ignores the concept entirely — no dawn, no driver's seat, just pure filler. Primary_text is built almost entirely of phrases any carrier could use: 'exciting opportunity', 'dynamic team', 'competitive pay', 'family atmosphere', 'truly value our drivers'. Only one real fact ($0.68/mile) survives. Spanish is a word-for-word mirror of the English filler, nothing trade-specific.

Hook puts the reader in the cab at dawn and leads with a rate — good concept execution — but the rate ($0.72/mile) and bonus ($5,000) are not in the facts, making both figures fabricated. Primary_text is extremely thin: no carrier name, no route, no schedule, no benefits listed. Spanish is otherwise serviceable with 'milla' and trade terms, but the false figures carry through.
